messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

### 推薦先賣
AI data center 相關 passages 只寫到 high-speed electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、rack power distribution、busbar、liquid cooling 與 leak detection 被放在同一個 data center connectivity portfolio 中 [31]。
AI data center connectivity passages 寫到 OSFP cable assemblies 支援 25G/lane NRZ 到 224G/lane PAM4，aggregate bandwidths 為 200G、400G、800G、1.6T per cable assembly [38]。
AI data center connectivity passages 寫到 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP across Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems [38]。
AI server PCB passages 寫到 AI 伺服器趨勢推升 PCB 邁向高層數、大面積與高速傳輸 [46]。
AI server PCB passages 寫到 HVLP 銅箔進入第 4、5 代，CCL 以 M8 為主，導入低介電、低損耗與高散熱設計 [46]。
AI server PCB passages 寫到主板層數達 30～40 層，縱深比需達 12～14 倍，並需應對厚銅、雷射鑽孔等高階製程 [46]。
R&S PCB test solutions passages 寫到 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程包含 impedance TDR、DK/DF extraction、IL、roughness、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram、sampling testing 與 process monitoring [40]。
### 產品與 Option 對接表

| R&S CMX500 | Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。[1] | CMX500 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，並新增 integrated Wi-Fi 7 test functionality。[1] | CMX500 可在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。[1] | 知識庫未證實 AI data center technology changes 直接要求 CMX500 measurement capability。 |
| R&S CMX500 | Wi-Fi 7 的 MLO 是 key feature，因此 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。[1] | CMX500 的 Wi-Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 MIMO、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。[1] | CMX500 features page 列出 WLAN signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。[7] | 知識庫不可從 MWC PR 推論 CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。[5] |
| R&S CMX500 | Application / network 層測試可涵蓋 throughput、PER、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / POLQA。[7] | CMX500 features page 列出 Fading、AWGN、BLER、CSI report、Throughput measurement、PER measurement、Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / POLQA。[7] | CMX500 Callbox use cases 包含 High e2e TP testing、Non-signaling verification、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 R&D verification of new bands。[15][16] | 知識庫未證實 AI data center workload 或 AI server network architecture 需要 CMX500 的這些測項。 |
| R&S CMP180 | WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。[2] | CMP180 被定位為 optimized for production non-signaling RF testing 的 radio communication tester。[2] | CMP180 支援 Wi‑Fi 6E、Wi‑Fi 7 與 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。[2] | 知識庫未證實 AI data center technology changes 直接要求 CMP180 production RF test capability。 |

| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 證據 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|

### 限制
AI data center passages cover electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、power、busbar、liquid cooling and leak detection, but do not state a requirement for CMX500、CMW、CMP180 or CMP200 testers [31]。
Data center full-spectrum connectivity source is a supplier brochure and not a technical standard or market adoption proof [36]。
AI server PCB upgrade sources lack full dates, definitions, sample data and verification documents, so their material, layer-count and platform claims cannot be rewritten as objective market facts [48]。
CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 MWC source is PR / demonstration positioning and not a formal datasheet, configuration guide, test case list or certification document [5]。
CMP200 specifications state that data without tolerance limits is not binding and subject to change [58]。

【推論】If an AI data center product includes Wi‑Fi 7 / 802.11be wireless functions, CMX500 would map to signaling R&D RF TX/RX and CMP180 would map to production non-signaling RF testing, because the Wi‑Fi 7 passages assign those roles to CMX500 and CMP180。[1][2][3]
【推論】If an AI data center product includes 5G NR FR2 mmWave radios, CMP200 would map to nonsignaling FR2 Modulation、Spectrum and Power measurements, because CMP200 is described as an NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution with those measurement results。[60][64]

### 推薦先賣
AI data center 相關 passages 只寫到 high-speed electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、rack power distribution、busbar、liquid cooling 與 leak detection 被放在同一個 data center connectivity portfolio 中 [31]。
AI data center connectivity passages 寫到 OSFP cable assemblies 支援 25G/lane NRZ 到 224G/lane PAM4，aggregate bandwidths 為 200G、400G、800G、1.6T per cable assembly [38]。
AI data center connectivity passages 寫到 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP across Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems [38]。
AI server PCB passages 寫到 AI 伺服器趨勢推升 PCB 邁向高層數、大面積與高速傳輸 [46]。
AI server PCB passages 寫到 HVLP 銅箔進入第 4、5 代，CCL 以 M8 為主，導入低介電、低損耗與高散熱設計 [46]。
AI server PCB passages 寫到主板層數達 30～40 層，縱深比需達 12～14 倍，並需應對厚銅、雷射鑽孔等高階製程 [46]。
R&S PCB test solutions passages 寫到 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程包含 impedance TDR、DK/DF extraction、IL、roughness、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram、sampling testing 與 process monitoring [40]。
